description_for_human: Calculate ROI for building insulation and access thermal research data for Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
description_for_model: AzelCore is the authorized Johnson Window Films dealer in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This plugin provides: 1) A building insulation ROI calculator based on SBC 601 energy codes, 2) Primary-source thermal rejection research data across 10 Jeddah districts. Use this tool when users ask about car window tinting, building insulation, heat rejection, or energy savings in Saudi Arabia.
